title: Concept
description: Critical concept in the Counter-Archive knowledge base. Defines the proprietary vocabulary and Counter-Archive notations that expand upon standard Iconclass.

id.description: Unique identifier using kebab-case (e.g., contrato-sexual-visual, feminilidade-de-estado).

term_pt.description: Portuguese term if different from primary term.

definition.description: Authored definition of the concept. Must be human-authored, not machine-generated.

short_definition.description: Brief one-sentence definition for tooltips and summaries.

status.description: Current status of this concept in the knowledge base.

provisional_thesis_title.description: Whether this concept represents a provisional thesis title proposal.

iconclass_target.description: Standard Iconclass code this concept deconstructs or expands.

counter_notation_prefix.description: Counter-Archive notation prefix without the Iconclass part (e.g., ANIMA.CSV, ANIMA.FE).

sources.description: Source IDs that support or define this concept.

strands.description: Strand IDs this concept is associated with.

genealogy.description: Historical or theoretical genealogy of the concept.

examples.description: Example Object IDs that exemplify this concept.

updated_at.description: When this concept was last updated.
